method: Over every cross that has at least one order, in any state. A wallet counts as own on a cross when it is in OWN_WALLETS or is that cross's creator, proceeds recipient, integrator or protocol fee recipient. A wallet is own overall only if it is own on every cross it appears in; otherwise it is external. Any wallet we operate that is neither listed nor one of those roles (throwaway test wallets created on the fly, for instance) is still counted as external, so the external figures are an upper bound on outside users, loosest when OWN_WALLETS is unset. Wallets are addresses, not people.
verdict: external wallets seen, ownership list not configured (upper bound)
